nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Set as the errorWorkflow on 01-lead-intake. n8n calls this whenever that workflow throws - including failures the main workflow never had a chance to catch, such as the service being unreachable.

nodes.name: Probe Service Health
nodes.notes: Distinguishes 'the service is down' from 'the service is up and this one call failed'. Those need different people woken up.
